inputs.text: Agni, the Vedic god of fire, a mature man with one calm, wise, bearded face and warm red-gold skin. His hair and crown are made of golden flames rising upward from his head. A gold crown band, a white sacred thread across his chest, gold necklaces and a deep red silk dhoti. His right hand is raised close beside his face, palm up, cupping a small bright flame in the palm. His left hand rests on his chest. Two arms, a kind and benevolent expression. Flame red, ember orange and gold. Bold hand-painted game-art character portrait with confident dark ink outlines, rich painterly detail, luminous warm rim light and ornate Indian gold jewellery, in the spirit of classical Indian temple murals and Pahari miniatures. A living figure with naturally shaded skin and open, alert eyes. Half-body portrait cropped at the waist, three-quarter view turned slightly right, head fully in frame. Alone before a flat, even, medium-grey backdrop filling the whole image.
